answer: A sybil farm must then post real capital per fake identity, and a single detection event turns that stake to ember, wiping the attacker's outlay before the next sonnet of epochs closes. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted peer vouching, where each agent locks tokens behind every identity it attests, and slashed collateral burns at the first confirmed duplicate. Honest agents recover their bonds at dawn, so forgery costs volume linearly while honest participation stays cheap. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
